# Comparison of literature search versions
# v1 = tiered free-text search
# v2 = unified query with evidence stratification

```{r setup and label construction}
#| echo: true
#| output: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(here)
library(readr)

v1 <- read_tsv(here("evaluation/labels/launched_drug_with_literature.tsv"))
v2 <- read_tsv(here("evaluation/labels/launched_drug_with_literature_v2.tsv"))

LEVELS <- c("clinical_study", "human_subject", "animal", "in_vitro", "other")

# join key, v1 and v2 may differ in capitalisation
v1 <- v1 %>% mutate(drug = tolower(drug_name))
v2 <- v2 %>% mutate(drug = tolower(drug_name))

# v1 label: a drug was positive if the tiered search stopped at an HDT tier
v1 <- v1 %>%
  mutate(
    v1_positive = search_type == "Direct (HDT)",
    v1_any      = search_type != "No Results"
  )

# v2 labels
v2 <- v2 %>%
  mutate(
    n_primary = n_clinical_study + n_human_subject + n_animal + n_in_vitro + n_other,
    n_host    = n_clinical_study + n_human_subject + n_animal + n_in_vitro,
    n_in_vivo = n_clinical_study + n_animal,

    HDT_any      = n_hdt > 0,
    HDT_host     = n_hdt > 0 & n_host > 0,
    HDT_in_vivo  = n_hdt > 0 & n_in_vivo > 0,
    HDT_clinical = n_hdt > 0 & n_clinical_study > 0,

    L0_any      = unique_articles > 0,
    L1_primary  = n_primary > 0,
    L2_host     = n_host > 0,
    L3_in_vivo  = n_in_vivo > 0,
    L4_clinical = n_clinical_study > 0
  )

cmp <- inner_join(v1, v2, by = "drug", suffix = c("_v1", "_v2"))
```

```{r label counts}
cat("drugs in v1        :", nrow(v1), "\n")
cat("drugs in v2        :", nrow(v2), "\n")
cat("drugs in both      :", nrow(cmp), "\n")
cat("only in v1         :", length(setdiff(v1$drug, v2$drug)), "\n")
cat("only in v2         :", length(setdiff(v2$drug, v1$drug)), "\n")
```

```{r retrieval comparison}
retrieval <- cmp %>%
  summarise(
    `drugs with any result, v1` = sum(v1_any),
    `drugs with any result, v2` = sum(L0_any),
    `median records, v1`        = median(studies_found[v1_any]),
    `median records, v2`        = median(unique_articles[L0_any]),
    `total records, v2`         = sum(unique_articles),
    `drugs truncated at cap`    = sum(results_truncated)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "statistic", values_to = "value")

print(retrieval, n = Inf)
```

```{r label agreement}
agreement <- cmp %>%
  count(v1_positive, HDT_host) %>%
  mutate(status = case_when(
    v1_positive &  HDT_host ~ "positive in both",
    v1_positive & !HDT_host ~ "lost, positive only in v1",
    !v1_positive & HDT_host ~ "gained, positive only in v2",
    TRUE                    ~ "negative in both"
  ))

print(agreement)

cat("\nv1 positives :", sum(cmp$v1_positive), "\n")
cat("v2 positives :", sum(cmp$HDT_host), "\n")
cat("net change   :", sum(cmp$HDT_host) - sum(cmp$v1_positive), "\n")

# the drugs that changed status, name these in the response letter
cat("\nlost (v1 positive, no host-directed evidence in v2):\n")
print(cmp %>% filter(v1_positive, !HDT_host) %>%
        select(drug, n_hdt, n_other, n_review, all_of(paste0("n_", LEVELS))))

cat("\ngained (not positive in v1, HDT plus host evidence in v2):\n")
print(cmp %>% filter(!v1_positive, HDT_host) %>%
        select(drug, n_hdt, all_of(paste0("n_", LEVELS))) %>%
        arrange(desc(n_hdt)), n = 30)
```

```{r what the v1 label was made of}
cmp %>%
  filter(v1_positive) %>%
  count(highest_evidence_level) %>%
  mutate(
    highest_evidence_level = factor(highest_evidence_level,
                                    levels = c(LEVELS, "none")),
    pct = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  arrange(highest_evidence_level) %>%
  print()

cmp %>%
  filter(v1_positive) %>%
  count(highest_evidence_level) %>%
  mutate(highest_evidence_level = factor(highest_evidence_level,
                                         levels = rev(c(LEVELS, "none")))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = highest_evidence_level)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4C72B0") +
  labs(
    title = "Strongest evidence level available for drugs labelled positive in v1",
    x = "drugs",
    y = "highest evidence level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

```{r evidence composition across the corpus}
cmp %>%
  slice_max(unique_articles, n = 25) %>%
  select(drug, all_of(paste0("n_", LEVELS))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-drug, names_to = "level", values_to = "records") %>%
  mutate(level = factor(sub("^n_", "", level), levels = rev(LEVELS))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = records, y = reorder(drug, records, sum), fill = level)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", direction = -1) +
  labs(
    title = "Evidence composition of the 25 most represented drugs",
    x = "records",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "evidence level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

```{r summary for the response letter}
summary_tbl <- tibble(
  statistic = c(
    "drugs evaluated",
    "positives, v1 label (Direct (HDT))",
    "positives, HDT_any",
    "positives, HDT_host",
    "drugs losing the label under HDT_host",
    "drugs gaining the label under HDT_host",
    "records classified, v2",
    "records at other (pathogen-directed), %",
    "records flagged as review, %",
    "records without MeSH indexing, %",
    "drugs truncated at retrieval cap"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(cmp),
    sum(cmp$v1_positive),
    sum(cmp$HDT_any),
    sum(cmp$HDT_host),
    sum(cmp$v1_positive & !cmp$HDT_host),
    sum(!cmp$v1_positive & cmp$HDT_host),
    sum(cmp$unique_articles),
    round(100 * sum(cmp$n_other) / sum(cmp$n_primary), 1),
    round(100 * sum(cmp$n_review) / (sum(cmp$n_primary) + sum(cmp$n_review)), 1),
    round(100 * sum(cmp$n_not_indexed) / sum(cmp$n_primary), 1),
    sum(cmp$results_truncated)
  )
)

print(summary_tbl, n = Inf)
```
